query:

Options:

D. Maya

[10] (about=Theo, core, t18 @2025-11-03T17:01:00) Theo reluctantly agrees to pay the equal split for this weekend despite thinking it's unfair.
[11] (about=Theo, core, t14 @2025-10-20T17:05:00) agrees with Devon on the split rule being unfair; he has one drink and a soda all night and pays the same as Whit who is on the wine list
[12] (about=GROUP, said_by=Theo, group-interaction, t0 @2025-09-01T19:02:00) Theo notes Devon skipped two reunions in a row
agent_answer:
C. Devon.

Devon clearly cuts against the equal-split rule: he thinks it is unfair because he drinks less than half of what some others drink and feels the bar tab is “carrying everyone.”
